WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    p.currency_code,
    COUNT(*) AS payout_count,
    SUM(p.gross_amount) AS total_gross_native,
    SUM(p.fee_amount) AS total_fee_native,
    SUM(p.gross_amount / er.rate) AS total_gross_eur,
    SUM(p.fee_amount / er.rate) AS total_fee_eur
  FROM payouts p
  JOIN exchange_rates er
    ON er.base_code = 'EUR'
    AND er.quote_code = p.currency_code
    AND er.as_of = date(p.paid_at)
  WHERE p.status = 'paid'
    AND p.paid_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND p.paid_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY p.currency_code
)
SELECT
  currency_code,
  payout_count,
  ROUND(total_gross_native, 2) AS total_gross_native,
  ROUND(total_fee_native, 2) AS total_fee_native,
  ROUND(total_gross_eur, 2) AS total_gross_eur,
  ROUND(total_fee_eur, 2) AS total_fee_eur,
  ROUND(total_fee_native / NULLIF(total_fee_eur,0), 4) AS implied_avg_rate_native_per_eur,
  ROUND(100 * total_fee_eur / SUM(total_fee_eur) OVER (), 2) AS share_of_total_fee_eur_pct
FROM agg
ORDER BY total_fee_eur DESC, currency_code ASC
note: Aggregated payouts (status='paid', paid_at in 2025) per currency before converting, joining exchange_rates 1:1 by (EUR, currency, as_of=date(paid_at)) — no fan-out joins, matching the validated methodology.
